pages.text: The $(item)Apprentice Clothes$() are the tunic, leggings and boots worn by the Keyblade wielders of the $(thing)Unions$(). They can't be crafted, but any $(thing)Foreteller$() will sell you each piece in exchange for $(thing)Lux$().

A $(item)Cloth Station$() lets you change their look. Place a piece in the top slot, pick one of the $(thing)4 designs$() and add dyes on the left for the primary colour and on the right for the secondary one.$(p)Taking the result uses up the piece and one of each dye.
